status: draft until recording and gate review finish

changes.before: Open the masks subfolder inside Source. Each image has a same-stem mask TIFF. Inspect the figures beside the original images, paying attention to missed objects and joined cells. The flow panel shows model directions used for segmentation.
changes.after: The masks subfolder inside Source contains a same-stem mask TIFF for each image. Inspect the figures beside the original images, paying attention to missed objects and joined cells. The flow panel shows model directions used for segmentation.

changes.before: Turn on Live preview and choose an image with the image picker. Open Live settings and check the channel and normalization controls. Collapse Console and System to give the preview more room if needed.
changes.after: Collapse the other result cards to give the preview more room. Turn on Live preview and choose an image with the image picker. Browse to the supplied example image.

changes.before: Compare the preview with the saved batch mask. Preview and Apply use different processing paths in this example, so they can produce different boundaries and counts. Review the saved TIFFs when deciding whether the batch outputs are suitable for measurement.
changes.after: Check the channel and normalization in Live settings, then run the preview. Preview and Apply process these images differently, so boundaries and counts can differ. Review the saved TIFFs when deciding whether the batch outputs are suitable for measurement.

changes.before: Use the mouse wheel to enlarge an area on both preview canvases. Inspect touching objects and dim boundaries, then zoom back out to check the complete field.
changes.after: Use the mouse wheel to enlarge an area on both preview canvases. Inspect touching objects and dim boundaries in the enlarged view.
